sections.heading: Current loop
sections.text: Dq-frame PI current controller. Crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10. Include dq decoupling: Vd_ff = -omega*L*Iq, Vq_ff = omega*L*Id. For LCL filter, add active damping via capacitor-current feedback gain R_d ~ 1/(3*Cf*omega_res).

sections.heading: Voltage loop
sections.text: DC-bus voltage PI controller. Crossover: f_cv ~ f_ci/10 ~ fsw/100. The voltage loop output sets the d-axis current reference. Anti-windup is critical because the current reference saturates.

sections.heading: Neutral-point balancing loop
sections.text: Separate slow loop that adjusts zero-vector dwell time. Bandwidth ~ f_ci/10. If balancing oscillates, reduce the gain. If it cannot converge, the DC-bus capacitors may be too small or the load is too unbalanced.
